role.altitude: The photonics engineer keeps designing optics, aligning setups, integrating components and judging results; reading instruments by hand, typing readings into spreadsheets, starting simulation runs one by one and compiling test data shrink.
skills_to_grow: Writing instrument control and batch simulation scripts
role.ambitious_version: An engineer whose test benches and simulations run overnight and whose mornings go to judging results.

tasks.short: Gather performance data, collect operational requirements, compute margins, analyze system performance against requirements, and document findings.

steps.what: Engineer gathers system performance data from tests and the field
Engineer collects operational requirements from specifications and customers
Engineer computes margins such as power budgets against the requirements
Engineer analyzes the results and judges where the system falls short
Engineer documents the findings

tasks.design: Test stations write results to a test database with a dashboard per system and condition, instead of the engineer compiling files. Requirements sit in a shared register. A script computes power budgets and other margins against the requirements. Judging where the system falls short stays with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test files were compiled and margins recalculated by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Test databases, requirement registers and scripted margin calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Field data that arrive only as customer complaints.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that a margin is fine on paper but not at temperature.

reach.learn: Whether test data are used sooner.

evidence.claim: Calculations, simulation and test data suit solvers, dashboards and statistics, with the solver as the check.

assumptions: Boundary: analysing performance and requirements; documenting design processes and outcomes (task 21056) is a sibling task.
s5 is part of documenting design processes and outcomes, which sibling task 21056 covers; its saving is counted there.
Input contract for s1: about 70% of test stations write to the test database; s1 is priced at that share.
unknowns: Share of tests run on connected stations.
research_questions: Are performance gaps found earlier in development?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few connected stations; high: most tests in the database.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set optical specifications, design the optical layout, run tolerance and performance simulations, develop image and signal processing, and review designs to develop optical or imaging systems.

steps.what: Engineer sets optical specifications from requirements
Engineer designs the optical layout of the imaging systems
Engineer runs tolerance and performance simulations
Engineer develops image and signal processing code

loop.input: The engineer's description of the processing step and the existing code.
loop.output: Draft code for routine parts such as file handling and filtering.
loop.check: Unit tests on known images must pass; the engineer reviews every change.
loop.stop: The engineer writes the code by hand when tests fail twice.
loop.why_not_simpler: Processing steps differ per optical system.

steps.what: Engineer reviews the design with the team

tasks.design: Tolerance and performance simulations run in batch from a script overnight, instead of the engineer starting and collecting each run. A code assistant drafts routine image and signal processing code, checked by unit tests on known images. Setting specifications, designing the layout and reviewing stay with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Simulation runs were started and collected one by one.
tasks.enabler_now: Batch simulation scripts and code assistants checked by tests.
tasks.still_hard: Novel optical designs outside known solution spaces.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing the design form that will be manufacturable.

evidence.claim: A simulation tool predicts new designs from past simulations; the vendor claims 10 to 100 times shorter cycles.
Experienced developers on real tasks were 19% slower with AI while believing they were faster.

assumptions: Boundary: developing optical and imaging systems; electro-optical sensing systems (task 18189) and design histories (task 18203) are sibling tasks.
s4 is priced low because measured results for experienced developers are mixed.
Specifying, designing and reviewing keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of design time spent waiting on simulations.
research_questions: Do design iterations per week rise?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few simulations; high: heavy tolerance analysis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan the test, build and align photonic prototypes or test setups, run measurements, record results, and evaluate them against specifications.

steps.what: Engineer plans the test of the photonic prototypes: setup, measurements and conditions
Engineer builds and aligns the prototype or test setup
Engineer runs the measurements and reads the instruments
Engineer types measurement results into the spreadsheet
Engineer evaluates the results against specifications

tasks.design: Instrument control scripts step through the measurement conditions and log readings with settings and time, instead of the engineer reading each instrument and typing the values. Building and aligning the setup and evaluating the results stay with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings were taken and typed by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Instrument control scripts with automatic logging.
tasks.still_hard: Setups that need realignment between measurements.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing a stray reflection that spoils the measurement.
tasks.altitude: Less reading and typing; building and judging stay.

evidence.claim: Instrument control scripts log measurements with their settings.

assumptions: Boundary: testing prototypes; transition to production (task 18202) is a sibling task.
s4 saves the second entry of instrument readings.
Input contract for s3: about 60% of instruments have remote control interfaces; s3 is priced at that share.
Planning, building and evaluating keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of instruments with remote control.
research_questions: Do test cycles per prototype shorten?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: manual instruments; high: fully scripted benches.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design photonics systems or components, integrate them by assembly, splicing and alignment, test them, record results and issues, and decide fixes.

steps.what: Engineer designs the photonics component or system
Engineer integrates components: assembly, fiber splicing and alignment
Engineer tests the integrated photonics systems
Engineer records test results and issues
Engineer decides fixes for failed tests

tasks.design: Automated test sequences run the standard checks on integrated systems and log results to the test database, instead of the engineer taking each reading and typing it in. Designing, integrating and deciding fixes stay with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tests were run step by step and results typed up.
tasks.human_edge: Getting a splice right the first time.
tasks.altitude: Less test admin; hands-on work stays.

reach.learn: Whether test sequences transfer to production.

evidence.claim: Automated test sequences log results with settings.

assumptions: Boundary: designing, integrating and testing; prototypes and models (task 18199) and design histories (task 18203) are sibling tasks.
s4 saves the second entry of readings into the spreadsheet.
Input contract for s3: standard checks scripted for about 60% of systems; s3 is priced at that share.
Designing, integrating and deciding keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of systems with standard test sequences.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: custom systems; high: repeat systems with standard tests.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
